name: DairyMilkQualityTracker
tagline: Milk collection quality, hygiene bands, quality payments and farm action plans in one Power Platform app.
description: A complete milk-quality module for dairy co-operatives, processors, milk-field teams and dairy farms: log tanker collections with litres, temperature, butterfat, protein, lactose, SCC, Bactoscan, antibiotic test and freezing point; grade every collection into hygiene bands A–D; estimate the milk value with composition and band bonuses or penalties; follow each farm's rolling SCC and plate-count geometric means against the legal limits; and run the alert → action plan → close workflow with owners, due dates, overrides and undo. Works the moment it is dropped (demo mode) and connects to collections, Dataverse, SharePoint, Excel or SQL in canvas apps, model-driven views and Power Pages (Web API).
features: Hygiene bands A–D from configurable SCC and Bactoscan limits
Temperature, added-water (freezing point) and minimum composition checks
Suggested status from results with live preview
Alert → Action plan → Closed workflow with required owner, due date, action and resolution
Override reason for clearing out-of-spec collections; undo
Rolling 3-month SCC and 2-month TBC geometric means vs legal limits per farm
Farm trend charts for SCC, Bactoscan, fat, protein and litres
Quality payment estimate per collection and farm (base, fat, protein, band, rejected)
Bulk action plan / close / retest with skip reasons, CSV export
16 quick filters with counts, filters drawer, grouping, sorting, paging
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard and screen-reader support
Power Fx outputs (KPIs, selection, ChangesJson, AlertListJson) and OnSelect/OnChange/OnCreate/OnSave/OnAction/OnStatusChange events
controlType: standard (two controls: DairyMilkQualityTracker data-set + DairyMilkQualityTrackerPortal field control, shared src/app)
